title: pvAMRFragmentIntegration
body:
## pvAMRFragmentIntegration

Integrates fragments previously labelled by pvAMRConnectivity: for each material array it reads the RegionId-<array name> cell labels and outputs a table (one block per material in a multiblock) with "Fragment ID", "Fragment Volume", "Fragment Mass" and one "Volume Weighted <name>" or "Mass Weighted <name>" column per selected array. Fragment volume is the volume fraction (0-255 scaled) times cell volume; mass is the sum of the chosen mass array. Use it for size and mass statistics of debris or droplets; pvAMRFragmentsFilter runs connectivity and integration together.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The input must come from pvAMRConnectivity with the same material arrays; otherwise the native filter reports that no RegionId array exists.
- Give exactly one mass array per material array, in the same order; the native code pairs them by position.
- Mass arrays are summed as they are, so they must hold mass per cell, not density.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AMRFragmentIntegration`. Identity: `filters/AMRFragmentIntegration`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the volume input of the filter. Accepted data: non-overlapping AMR data (vtkNonOverlappingAMR). The input needs at least one cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkNonOverlappingAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SelectMassArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine fragment mass | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SelectMassWeightedArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine mass weighted average values | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SelectMaterialArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine fragments | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SelectVolumeWeightedArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine volume weighted average values | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAMRFragmentIntegration",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
